title: Taj Mahal: 22 saal, 20,000 mazdoor - the real cost
source: Taj Mahal official site (Govt. of India / ASI) · National Geographic · Britannica

captions.instagram:
The Taj Mahal took twenty-two whole years... and about twenty thousand people!

Taj Mahal banane mein lage pure 22 saal aur lagbhag 20,000 log 🕌

🕌 Pure 22 saal (1631–1653) aur lagbhag 20,000 kaarigar! Main maqbara 1648 mein ban gaya tha, baag aur baaki imaaratein 5 saal baad.

Sources: Taj Mahal official site (tajmahal.gov.in), National Geographic, Britannica.
Photos: Paul and Jill / Flickr (CC BY 2.0); gregor_y / Flickr (CC BY-SA 2.0).

Verses:
• Construction of the Taj complex began about 1631 and the whole complex was finished in 1653 (about 22 years) — tajmahal.gov.in, Creation history
• About 20,000 workers were recruited from across northern India — tajmahal.gov.in, Creation history
• The main mausoleum was completed in 1648; the outlying buildings and gardens five years later, in 1653 — tajmahal.gov.in, Creation history
• The main mausoleum is built of white Makrana marble from Rajasthan — Makrana marble; EGU 2020 geology presentation
• Shah Jahan built it as a tomb for his wife Mumtaz Mahal — National Geographic; tajmahal.gov.in
